name: aktivite-giris
description: SAP danışmanlık aktivite takip & raporlama — React + Express + SQLite

scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm --workspace=server install --include=dev && npm --workspace=client install --include=dev
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && cd server && npx prisma generate
scripts.postinstall: cd server && npx prisma generate || true
scripts.start: cd server && (npx prisma migrate deploy || npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss) && node dist/index.js
